name: Default
shortDescription: WhatsApp Business platform with a shared team inbox, chatbots, campaigns and templates, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin@admin.com (ADMIN_EMAIL) with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment, then change the password in your profile. Keep ADMIN_EMAIL matching your admin email: each start recreates that account if it is missing.

You need a WhatsApp Business account in Meta Business Suite. Add its phone number ID, business account ID and access token under Settings > Accounts, and point the Meta webhook to https://<your domain>/api/webhook with WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN as the verify token.
HTTPS is required: the app runs in production mode with Secure cookies and only accepts its https:// origin, so a plain HTTP URL cannot sign in.
